en.text:
Ability kills grant <void/>Devour for 10 seconds (15 with <void/>Echo of Persistence). <bold (Prismatic Only: Kills with Shatter, Volatile Explosions, and Tangles also grant Devour />).

Your <void/>Devour is enhanced, granting twice as much HP (70HP🠚140 HP) and Grenade Ability Energy. 

Kills while <void/>Devour is active add 5 seconds to the timer (8 with <void/>Echo of Persistence). 
//Base devour behavior, doesn't need to be said?

Enhanced <void/>Devour Grenade Energy granted is based on <link Combatant Tier [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1: 15%
• Tier 2: 23.2%
• Tier 3: 27.5%
• Tier 4 or Players: 40%
